notes: Philadelphia Fair Workweek (Phila. Code ch. 9-4600) covers retail, food and hospitality employers with 250+ employees and 30+ locations worldwide, for employees working in Philadelphia.
Predictability pay: 1 hour for added time or changed date/time/location; no less than 0.5x pay for scheduled hours cut or cancelled (extra key reduced_hours_fraction).
Right to rest: no shift less than 9 hours after the previous day's shift unless the employee consents and is paid $40 (extra key premium_flat_dollars).
No city minimum-wage rule recorded for private employers (Pennsylvania state minimum wage applies).

rules.summary: Covered retail employers (250+ employees, 30+ locations) must post schedules 14 days ahead and pay predictability pay for later changes.

citation.title: Philadelphia Office of Worker Protections — Fair Workweek FAQ (Dec. 2023)
citation.excerpt: The work schedule must be posted no later than 14 days before the first day of any new Work Week.

rules.summary: Employees may not be scheduled less than 9 hours after the previous day's shift unless they consent and are paid $40.

citation.title: Philadelphia Office of Worker Protections — Fair Workweek FAQ (Dec. 2023)
citation.excerpt: Employees shall not be scheduled less than nine hours after the end of the previous day's shift ... unless the employee provides consent and payment of $40.
